verses.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.pt: Porque sabemos que, se a nossa casa terrestre deste tabernáculo se desfizer, temos de Deus um edifício, uma casa não feita por mãos, eterna, nos céus.
verses.en_web: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: For we are conscious that if this our tent of flesh is taken down, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in heaven.

verses.en: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.pt: Pois neste tabernáculo nós gememos, desejando muito ser revestidos da nossa habitação que é do céu,
verses.en_web: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven;
verses.en_bbe: For in this we are crying in weariness, greatly desiring to be clothed with our house from heaven:

verses.en: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.pt: se é que, estando vestidos, não formos achados nus.
verses.en_web: if so be that being clothed we will not be found naked.
verses.en_bbe: So that our spirits may not be unclothed.

verses.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.pt: Porque, na verdade, nós, os que estamos neste tabernáculo, gememos oprimidos, porque não queremos ser despidos, mas sim revestidos, para que o mortal seja absorvido pela vida.
verses.en_web: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened; not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
verses.en_bbe: For truly, we who are in this tent do give out cries of weariness, for the weight of care which is on us; not because we are desiring to be free from the body, but so that we may have our new body, and death may be overcome by life.

verses.en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.pt: Ora, quem para isto mesmo nos preparou foi Deus, o qual nos deu como penhor o Espírito.
verses.en_web: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Now he who has made us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a witness of what is to come.

verses.en: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.pt: Temos, portanto, sempre bom ânimo, sabendo que, enquanto estamos presentes no corpo, estamos ausentes do Senhor
verses.en_web: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
verses.en_bbe: So, then, we are ever without fear, and though conscious that while we are in the body we are away from the Lord,

verses.en: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.pt: (porque andamos por fé, e não por vista);
verses.en_web: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
verses.en_bbe: (For we are walking by faith, not by seeing,)

verses.en: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.pt: temos bom ânimo, mas desejamos antes estar ausentes deste corpo, para estarmos presentes com o Senhor.
verses.en_web: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: We are without fear, desiring to be free from the body, and to be with the Lord.

verses.en: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
verses.pt: Pelo que também nos esforçamos para ser-lhe agradáveis, quer presentes, quer ausentes.
verses.en_web: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason we make it our purpose, in the body or away from it, to be well-pleasing to him.

verses.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.pt: Porque é necessário que todos nós sejamos manifestos diante do tribunal de Cristo, para que cada um receba o que fez por meio do corpo, segundo o que praticou, o bem ou o mal.
verses.en_web: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
verses.en_bbe: For we all have to come before Christ to be judged; so that every one of us may get his reward for the things done in the body, good or bad.

verses.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.pt: Portanto, conhecendo o temor do Senhor, procuramos persuadir os homens; mas, a Deus já somos manifestos, e espero que também nas vossas consciências sejamos manifestos.
verses.en_web: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God; and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
verses.en_bbe: Having in mind, then, the fear of the Lord, we put these things before men, but God sees our hearts; and it is my hope that we may seem right in your eyes.

verses.en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.pt: Não nos recomendamos outra vez a vós, mas damo-vos ocasião de vos gloriardes por nossa causa, a fim de que tenhais resposta para os que se gloriam na aparência, e não no coração.
verses.en_web: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.en_bbe: We are not again requesting your approval, but we are giving you the chance of taking pride in us, so that you may be able to give an answer to those whose glory is in seeming, and not in the heart.

verses.en: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
verses.pt: Porque, se enlouquecemos, é para Deus; se conservamos o juízo, é para vós.
verses.en_web: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
verses.en_bbe: For if we are foolish, it is to God; or if we are serious, it is for you.

verses.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.pt: Pois o amor de Cristo nos constrange, porque julgamos assim: se um morreu por todos, logo todos morreram;
verses.en_web: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
verses.en_bbe: For it is the love of Christ which is moving us; because we are of the opinion that if one was put to death for all, then all have undergone death;

verses.en: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.pt: e ele morreu por todos, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si, mas para aquele que por eles morreu e ressuscitou.
verses.en_web: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
verses.en_bbe: And that he underwent death for all, so that the living might no longer be living to themselves, but to him who underwent death for them and came back from the dead.

verses.en: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
verses.pt: Por isso daqui por diante a ninguém conhecemos segundo a carne; e, ainda que tenhamos conhecido Cristo segundo a carne, contudo agora já não o conhecemos desse modo.
verses.en_web: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, from this time forward we have knowledge of no man after the flesh: even if we have had knowledge of Christ after the flesh, we have no longer any such knowledge.

verses.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.pt: Pelo que, se alguém está em Cristo, nova criatura é; as coisas velhas já passaram; eis que tudo se fez novo.
verses.en_web: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
verses.en_bbe: So if any man is in Christ, he is in a new world: the old things have come to an end; they have truly become new.

verses.en: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.pt: Mas todas as coisas provêm de Deus, que nos reconciliou consigo mesmo por Cristo, e nos confiou o ministério da reconciliação;
verses.en_web: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.en_bbe: But all things are of God, who has made us at peace with himself through Christ, and has given to us the work of making peace;

verses.en: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.pt: pois que Deus estava em Cristo reconciliando consigo o mundo, não imputando aos homens as suas transgressões; e nos encarregou da palavra da reconciliação.
verses.en_web: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
verses.en_bbe: That is, that God was in Christ making peace between the world and himself, not putting their sins to their account, and having given to us the preaching of this news of peace.

verses.en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.pt: De sorte que somos embaixadores por Cristo, como se Deus por nós vos exortasse. Rogamo-vos, pois, por Cristo que vos reconcilieis com Deus.
verses.en_web: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
verses.en_bbe: So we are the representatives of Christ, as if God was making a request to you through us: we make our request to you, in the name of Christ, be at peace with God.

verses.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.pt: Âquele que não conheceu pecado, Deus o fez pecado por nós; para que nele fôssemos feitos justiça de Deus.
verses.en_web: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
verses.en_bbe: For him who had no knowledge of sin God made to be sin for us; so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.
